lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular spots are arranged in a staggered grid posterior to the gill slits. The inter-spot distance increases slightly along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating anchor nodes at the points of overlap.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical pixel gradient featuring a high-intensity highlight on the dorsal edge and a low-intensity shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora is visible near the ventral side of the main body. The pectoral fin shows a high density of high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller in diameter than the spots on the lateral flank.
